meaning:
ψευδο-προφήτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Zec.13:2, Jer.1:9 (Jer.6:13, al.) (נָבִיא)* ;]
a false prophet (= cl. ψευδόμαντις): Mat.7:15 24:11, 24, Mrk.13:22 (see Swete, in l), Luk.6:26, Act.13:6, 2Pe.2:1, 1Jn.4:1, Rev.16:13 19:20 20:10 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the…
Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something…
